title: Don't Be Shy
plot_overview: After her longtime boyfriend ends their relationship, a confident young woman finds herself on the outs and sets out to get even. But her plans take an unexpected turn as she forms a friendship with his new girlfriend, leading her toward compassion and a fresh perspective.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like coming-of-age stories about identity, awkwardness, and emotional growth; Not for you if you dislike predictable turns or stories whose pacing dips in the second half.
review_summary: Pros: endearing coming-of-age story; relatable emotional growth; lively lead performance | Cons: uneven second half; predictable turns; pacing slows
